reason: The official weather workbook contains measured Radiation_North, Radiation_East, Radiation_South, and Radiation_West channels. The object engine previously discarded them and reconstructed all vertical-plane forcing with an isotropic model from GHI, DHI, and calculated solar position. Protocol 1.6 freezes typed optional cardinal-plane forcing and uses a measured plane only for an exactly matching vertical cardinal surface. Nonvertical surfaces continue through the analytical plane-of-array path.
unchanged_from_v1_5_1: distinct SUA supply and EHA exhaust terms
opaque sol-air equation and declared surface properties
all source schedules and physical parameters

corrected_forcing.vertical_cardinal_surfaces: use the matching measured Radiation_North/East/South/West value
corrected_forcing.roof_and_noncardinal_surfaces: retain NREL-SPA position plus isotropic plane-of-array calculation
corrected_forcing.array_backend: reject measured vertical-plane forcing until equivalent kernels exist
